entities.description: A close-up view of a wet, cobblestone alleyway with two people walking away from the camera, an adult and a child, holding hands. The adult is wearing dark pants and a dark jacket, while the child is wearing a blue puffer jacket, blue jeans, and brown boots. The cobblestones are glistening with water, reflecting the overcast sky, and the alley is flanked by stone walls on both sides.

A rustic stone building with a rough, uneven facade made of variously sized rocks and mortar, featuring a tall arched wooden door and a black metal lantern mounted on a decorative bracket. The structure appears old and weathered, with a vertical drainpipe running down the side and a small balcony visible in the background.

A close-up view of a rustic stone wall featuring a wooden door set within a smooth, light-colored stone archway. The wall is constructed from irregular, rough-hewn stones in varying shades of gray and brown, while the door is a dark, weathered wood with a simple rectangular design and a small, dark handle.

A blurry, out-of-focus background showing the upper facade of a light beige or cream-colored building with a dark, sloped roof and a chimney. A dark, rectangular structure, possibly a balcony or window frame, is visible on the right side.

A rustic stone building with a rough, uneven facade made of mixed brown and grey rocks, featuring arched doorways and windows framed by smooth grey stone. A dark vertical drainpipe runs down the side of the structure, and the roof is covered in reddish-brown tiles, set against a wet, cobblestone street.

The image is slightly out of focus, giving it a soft, blurred appearance, with a wet cobblestone street visible at the bottom.

A multi-story building constructed from rough-hewn, light brown and grey stone blocks features a sloped roof with terracotta tiles and a dark gutter system. The structure includes a tall, narrow window on the upper level and an arched opening on the ground floor, with a potted plant visible near the base, all rendered in a soft, out-of-focus style.

A young child with light brown hair is seen from behind, walking away on a wet cobblestone street while holding the hand of an adult. The child wears a dark navy blue puffy winter jacket with a hood, blue jeans, and brown boots.
